query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
facility as "Facility",
department as "Department",
location_group as "Area",
request_id as "Request ID",
to_char(((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Request date and time",
supervising_clinician as "Supervising clinician",
requesting_clinician as "Requesting clinician",
priority as "Priority",
imaging_type as "Imaging type",
imaging_area as "Area to be imaged",
status as "Status",
to_char(((completed_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Completed date and time",
reason_for_cancellation as "Reason for cancellation"
from "reporting"."ds__imaging_requests"
where ((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((requested_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:requestedById is null then true
else requesting_clinician_id = 
:requestedById
end
and
case
when 
:imagingType is null then true
else imaging_type_id = 
:imagingType
end
and
case
when 
:statusId is null then true
else status_id = 
:statusId
end
and
case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
order by requested_datetime
name: Imaging requests line list
notes:
This report generates a list of all patients that have had an imaging request created and details of that imaging request for the selected parameters. Patients are listed in chronological order based on the lab request date and time. 

If an imaging request has more than one area to be imaged than the request will be reported across multiple lines. The report includes imaging requests with all statuses and if a request has been cancelled will display the reason for cancellation.
